summary: The game cycle as a graph (title -> play -> over | win -> retry or menu), a level menu on the floor (the hero circles to a level, Fire goes; keys 1 2 3 too), score and best, an almost bare HUD (score and lives, two rings, boss life arcs on the floor), italic title / pause / result screens, music loops, and the PBR Neutral look for neon colours.

bind.when: (is(game, title) or is(game, over) or is(game, win)) and not paused
is(game, title) and not paused and abs(wrap(angle(player) + 90)) < 32
is(game, title) and not paused and abs(wrap(angle(player))) < 32
is(game, title) and not paused and abs(wrap(angle(player) - 90)) < 32
is(game, play) and hp(hex) > 0 and not is(hex, dormant)
is(game, play) and emote == 1 and time < emote_until
is(game, play) and emote == 2 and time < emote_until
is(game, play) and emote == 3 and time < emote_until
is(game, play) and emote == 4 and time < emote_until
is(game, play) and emote == 5 and time < emote_until

text.s: CIRCLE TO CHOOSE      J / CLICK  GO

rules.when: is(play) and power > 1 and hp(player) < hp_seen

notes: Apply shapes (polynite_shape upsert) before the hud op. Screens are show:"hidden" and appear by their when; each entrance replays. The menu: one world shape per level (dim text + arc) and one for its lit text, v0 = abs(wrap(angle(player) - a)) < 32. A progress ring with its own text inside takes show_value:0. The game graph reads hp(player), hp(boss), hp(hex), grazes(player), mode; rename to fit.
